description: The HIPP 8155 (8155PP5/8155PP5-G) security processors are highly-integrated cryptographic processors capable of performing DES, 3DES, ARC4, AES (128, 192, 256 bit), MD5, SHA-1 and HMAC at speeds up to full-duplex OC-12. The 8155’s on-board DPU processes protocols based on the available hardware algorithms. This currently includes IPv4/IPv6, IPsec, SSL, IPPCP and PPTP.
